title: Quarterly Conductor — Cross-cycle orchestration for Hosted API & Model Catalog readiness
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Objective: create a single canonical quarterly 'conductor' artifact that orchestrates timing, gating criteria, and cross-team handoffs for Hosted API runway and the model catalog ready-to-ship list. This ticket produces: 1) a prioritized readiness checklist per endpoint/model, 2) a canary calendar that maps capacity and SLA constraints to model rotations, 3) clear guardrails for regressions (e.g., eval pass thresholds, latency/cost deltas) and 4) the stakeholder signoff flow (PM -> Eng -> Design -> SRE -> Security). Motivations: reduce last-minute roll-blockers, clarify canary windows versus capacity hedges, and create signal templates for post-deploy monitoring. Deliverables: Confluence PRD link, a minimal spreadsheet for readiness status, a GitHub checklist template for release PRs, and updated runbook snippets for on-call. Success metrics: reduce late-sprint roll-blockers by 60% for this quarter; align 95% of model rotations with designated canary windows; 0 severity >P1 incidents caused by model swap within first 72h across canary cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: Readiness checklist created and populated for top 25 hosted endpoints and top 40 models
Canary calendar published and linked in the PRD with owner per window
Rollout gating criteria documented and approved by Security and SRE
Release PR checklist template merged in the repo (link to PR)
Smoke dashboard tile added to Console showing early indicators (latency, error rate, unit-cost delta)
